source: The actual abc and adb Vertex permutations in research/nima/agda/NativeSeedTransitionProbe.agda; close under composition to obtain A4.
syntax: Free monoid of finite lists of the eight named generators on the one object X. No path-endpoint restrictions, relations, quotient, implicit resets, measurement commands or additional controls.
composition: Chronological list concatenation: eval(u ++ v,x)=eval(v,eval(u,x)). The empty word is identity.
initialization: An explicitly supplied g in A4 and pointer false. Correctness of generator implementations is on all X, not only blank inputs.
observations: The Boolean pointer at authorized word boundaries; retain the complete successor (g,b) for all future continuations. Reading here is a mathematical function, not an inserted physical instrument.
history: Retain the literal word and intermediate states. Equal permutation semantics does not identify histories.

native_interpretation_specification.carrier: Embed each enumerated permutation g as its actual Vertex equivalence e_g, paired with the Boolean, in NativeQueryControlledRecorder.Carrier.
native_interpretation_specification.Q_e: Use NativeQueryControlledRecorder.native-record at the named endpoints; its blank correctness, native agreement and undo are already Agda-checked for every supplied Vertex equivalence.
native_interpretation_specification.L_h: Map (e,b) to (compEquiv e h,b), using the actual Query.ABC or Query.ADB. Retain its equivalence/marked-value attachment at the Complete package interface.
native_interpretation_specification.words: Chronological composition of those mapped operations, retaining the word and actual intermediate packages.
native_interpretation_specification.proof_boundary: This is the declared generator/word interpretation. The finite group embedding and L_h/all-word native amplitude comparison are not newly Agda-proved here; they remain Output-A proof obligations. No arbitrary target equivalence or desired output is an interpreter input.

negative_syntax_examples: implicit blank reset is not a generator
Q_AB;Q_AB is not the empty syntax word despite equal state semantics
scope: An explicitly supplied group-query task, not the original endpoint-typed six-edge traversal language and not a source-selected physical protocol grammar.
